items.title: 3.4.1 Sigma aur pi bonds ka banna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.4.1 and the pi bond section, printed pages 59-61.

blocks.text: Sigma bond saath wale atoms ke do aadhe bhare atomic orbitals ke khatti (linear) overlap se banta hai; orbitals nuclear mehwar par ek doosre ke qareeb aate hain. s aur p dono orbitals seedhe samne se (head-on) overlap kar ke sigma bonds bana sakte hain.

items: s-s overlap: ek atom ka s orbital doosre ke s orbital se overlap kar ke bond orbital deta hai. Yeh H2 ke banne mein hota hai, jahan har hydrogen atom ka aadha bhara s orbital hai; bond banne ke baad electrons jure hote hain aur electron density dono nuclei ke gird mutawazan hai.

blocks.alt: Hydrogen ke do s orbitals, har ek nucleus wala neela gola, 's Hydrogen' likha, darmiyan jama ka nishan, aur mota teer bayzawi (oval) H2 molecule ki taraf jis mein dono nuclei hain. Oval ke beech se laal teer 'Symmetrical Electron Density' wale dabbe ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.22: Do hydrogen atoms ke s orbitals ka overlap jo H2 molecule banata hai (kitab ki Figure 3.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: s-p overlap: ek atom ka s orbital doosre ke p orbital se overlap kar ke sigma bond banata hai. HCl mein hydrogen ka aadha bhara s orbital chlorine ke aadhe bhare p orbital se overlap karta hai; electron density chlorine atom ke qareeb zyada hai us ki zyada electronegativity ki wajah se, isi liye HCl polar molecule hai.

blocks.alt: Hydrogen atom ka 1s orbital jama chlorine atom ka 3p orbital (dumb-bell). Teer 'Overlap starts' ki taraf, jahan H ka gola Cl p orbital ke ek lobe ko chhoota hai. Phir teer 'Hydrogen chloride HCl' ki taraf, H ki taraf chhota aur Cl ki taraf bara lobe.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.23: s-p overlap se sigma bond ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.23 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: p-p overlap: Cl2 mein do chlorine atoms ke p orbitals nuclear mehwar par overlap karte hain; electron density dono nuclei ke gird mutawazan hai kyunke dono atoms ki electronegativity ek jaisi hai.

blocks.alt: Chlorine atoms ke do 3p orbitals, 'Atomic orbitals' likha. Teer jahan dono p orbitals Cl nuclei ke darmiyan sire se sire overlap karte hain. Phir teer Cl2 molecular orbital ki taraf: nuclei ke darmiyan bara lobe aur bahar chhote lobes, 'Molecular orbitals' aur 'Molecule' likha.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.24: VBT ke mutabiq p aur p orbitals ka overlap jo Cl2 molecule banata hai (kitab ki Figure 3.24 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: H2S molecule non-linear hai. Sulfur ke do 3p orbitals (maslan 3py aur 3pz), har ek mein ek electron, do hydrogen atoms ke 1s orbitals se overlap karte hain, jo 92 degrees ke bond zawiye wala v-shaped molecule banata hai. H2O mein bond zawiya 104.5 degrees hai jabke H2S mein 92 degrees, kyunke sulfur ke orbitals bare hain aur lone pair zyada dhakel lagata hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: mehwaron ke saath sulfur atom aur us ke 3p orbitals: do aadhe bhare 3p orbitals (halke, khaake wale) khare aur neeche-daen mehwar par aur ek bhara 3p orbital (gehra). Aadhe bhare lobes par do H atoms, 'Overlap' likhe khokhle teer, aur un ke darmiyan muRa dohra teer, 90 degrees. Daen: H2S, H-S-H, S par do hare lone pair lobes aur H-S-H zawiya 92 degrees.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.25: H aur S orbitals ke overlap se H2S molecule ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.25 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sulfur ke do aadhe bhare 3p orbitals ek doosre se 90 degrees par hain; har ek par ek H ka 1s orbital overlap karta hai. Is liye H-S-H zawiya taqreeban 90 hona chahiye; asal mein yeh 92 degrees hai kyunke do H atoms thora sa ek doosre ko dhakelte hain. Tasveer mein 90 degrees orbitals ka zawiya hai aur 92 degrees molecule ka.

Oxygen atoms ke darmiyan double bond, O=O, par ghaur karein. Har atom ke amood p orbitals, maslan px aur py, mein do ghair-jure electrons hain. Dono atoms ke px orbitals sire se sire tak, khatti taur par, overlap karte hain aur sigma bond dete hain. py orbitals ek doosre ke mutawazi (parallel) hain aur pehlu se overlap karte hain, do lobes nuclei ke plane ke oopar aur do neeche; yeh pi bond banata hai. Oxygen atoms sigma aur pi bond se double bonded hain.

blocks.alt: Do oxygen nuclei neele px lobes se jure jo beech mein sire se sire overlap karte hain, jahan gehre oval mein do ulte teer hain, 'sigma bond' likha. Har atom par y lakeer ke saath khare hare py lobes, oopar wale lobe mein oopar teer, Py likha. Laal qausein oopar ke lobes aur neeche ke lobes ko milati hain, har ek par 'pi bond'. Neeche: O=O.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.26: Oxygen atoms ke darmiyan double bond (sigma aur pi) ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.26 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: H2O aur N2 ki orbital banawat alfaz mein banayein, aur woh overlaps jo F2 aur HF banate hain.
blocks.explanation: H2O: oxygen ke do aadhe bhare 2p orbitals do hydrogen atoms ke 1s orbitals se overlap karte hain, do s-p sigma bonds; do lone pairs zawiya 104.5 degrees tak dhakelte hain. N2: har nitrogen ke teen ghair-jure 2p electrons hain; p orbitals ka ek jora sigma bond ke liye sire se sire overlap karta hai aur baqi do jore do pi bonds ke liye pehlu se, triple bond. F2: har fluorine ka aadha bhara 2p orbital seedha overlap karta hai, p-p sigma bond, mutawazan. HF: hydrogen ka 1s fluorine ke aadhe bhare 2p se overlap karta hai, s-p sigma bond jis ki density fluorine ki taraf khiski hai, to HF polar hai.

items: Sigma bond: nuclear mehwar par khatti overlap, s-s (H2), s-p (HCl, polar), p-p (Cl2). H2S: S ke do amood 3p orbitals 92 degrees ka zawiya dete hain (H2O 104.5).
Pi bond: mehwar ke oopar aur neeche mutawazi p orbitals ka pehlu se overlap; O=O ek sigma plus ek pi bond hai.
